verdict.summary: Round 4 remains correct and complete. The change gives ownership-map safe verdicts the same first-match semantics in change classification that closure selection already uses, while preserving the earlier precedence of full-run triggers and crates/** ownership. Map discovery and parsing degrade conservatively to the pre-change classifier, and all three workflow consumers recognize the new inert token consistently. The focused tests exercise the real select/classify and classify-only paths, protected ZK anchors, trigger and crate exclusions, mixed classifications, malformed or unavailable maps, default and explicit map discovery, workflow-token drift, and a mutation check. The implementation remains consistent with research/change-based-test-selection.md's SAFE-map and fail-closed rules. No correctness, soundness, security, test-vacuity, or prompt-injection issue is present in the supplied diff.
